objective: Match all six numbers of the corresponding target draw, regardless of order
selection_rule: Exact validation matches first; total partial matches and 2+ counts break ties, then method order

experiments.name: Decay · 5 draws
experiments.formula: s(n) = Σ 2^(-age/5) I(n in draw) / Σ weights

experiments.name: Decay · 12 draws
experiments.formula: s(n) = Σ 2^(-age/12) I(n in draw) / Σ weights

experiments.name: Gap recurrence
experiments.formula: s(n) = -|(draws absent + 1) - mean historical gap| / (mean gap + 1)

experiments.name: Next-draw associations
experiments.formula: s(n) = Σ over last-draw m: (next-draw count(m→n)+1)/(prior count(m)+2)

experiments.name: Rank ensemble
experiments.formula: s(n) = mean normalized ranks of hot, decay-12, recurrence, pairs, transitions
